source: Shopping Mall Sample 2 - PRE 2025 - REDACTED.pdf, Section 3 (pp. 6-8)

observations.note: hot work permit form reviewed - no fire watch requirement during or after hot work
no formal FP system impairment programme. isolations approved by tech service team only, no impairment permit
concealed spk cover plates painted over in retail corridor
FA panel showed 2 faults on arrival, both cleared during visit, fault log updated
loading bay cardboard waste removed daily, area clear at time of visit

reference:
Management Programs
2025-01 Improve Hot Work Permit. Priority 2. Type: Hot Work Permit. Effort: Minor Procedural.
Description: As per NFPA 51B, the permit form should require a constant fire watch throughout the hot work and for 30-60 minutes after, and the area should be monitored for at least 3 hours after the fire watch.
Observation: The hot work permit reviewed lacked requirements for fire watch during and post hot work.

2025-02 Formalize Fire Protection System Impairment Programme. Priority 2. Type: Fire Protection System Maintenance and Testing. Effort: Minor Procedural.
Description: Implement an impairment procedure with a formal Impairment Notification permit, in accordance with NFPA 25 Chapter 15: no high-risk work in impaired areas, authorised and supervised isolations, impairment forms to relevant parties, systems restored after works.
Observation: There is no formalized fire protection system impairment programme.

Physical Protection
2025-03 Replacement/Cleaning of Concealed Sprinkler Plates. Priority 2. Type: Fire Protection System Operation. Effort: Minor Capital.
Description: Cover plates should not be painted over, as this affects the temperature rating of the cover plate and may delay sprinkler activation.
Observation: Concealed sprinkler cover plates were found to be painted over.
